The total depends on combining both the base Section III limit and the TA21 add-on amount.

testCases.name: test_case_3
testCases.input: How much will I get if my two-wheeler bike's tyre is damaged, and does it matter whether I have the Tyre and Rim add-on?
testCases.expectedOutput: Under the base policy (Section I, Clause 2b), damage to tyres and tubes is only payable if the vehicle is damaged at the same time, and even then, liability is limited to 50% of the replacement cost. If the TA34 Tyre and Rim Secure add-on is opted, standalone tyre damage (not requiring simultaneous vehicle damage) is covered, with payout based on unused tread depth: <3mm not covered, 3-5mm = 50%, 5-7mm = 75%, ≥7mm = 100% of the cost of a new tyre/tube, up to a maximum of 2 replacements per policy period.

testCases.name: test_case_6
testCases.input: Is water damage to my electric two-wheeler's engine and battery covered, and what add-ons would I need?
testCases.expectedOutput: Standard engine water-ingress damage is covered under Add-on TA33 (Engine Secure), but this cover explicitly does NOT apply to electric vehicles. For electric vehicles, water-related battery/charging equipment damage (including ingress of water while charging) is instead covered under Add-on TA27 (Electric Surge Secure), which covers arcing, self-heating, leakage of electricity, or short-circuiting including water ingress while charging, up to the vehicle's IDV. testCases.input: If my checked baggage is delayed and I already received a payout for that, and it's later confirmed permanently lost, does the Loss of Checked Baggage claim account for the earlier delay payment?
testCases.expectedOutput: Yes. Under Section 4 (Loss of Checked Baggage), the Company's payment to the insured will be reduced by any payment already made under Section 14 (Delay of Checked Baggage), as well as by any sum for which the Airline is liable to pay. So if a delay payout was already received before the baggage was confirmed permanently lost, that amount is deducted from the final Section 4 settlement.
